description: This file defines the XmlBody class responsible for serializing AWS API request bodies into XML format using PHP's XMLWriter. It handles various AWS API shape types such as structures, lists, maps, timestamps, booleans, blobs, and strings, providing methods for constructing and formatting XML documents based on API shape definitions.

classes.name: XmlBody
classes.description: A class to serialize AWS API shapes into XML bodies for REST-XML services.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the XmlBody with a Service API instance.

methods.name: build
methods.description: Creates an XML string representation of the given shape and arguments.

methods.name: startElement
methods.description: Starts an XML element and writes namespace attributes if provided.

methods.name: format
methods.description: Formats a shape's value into XML by dispatching to specific 'add_*' methods based on shape type.

methods.name: defaultShape
methods.description: Default method to serialize simple types into XML element text.

methods.name: add_structure
methods.description: Serializes a structure shape into nested XML elements.

methods.name: getStructureMembers
methods.description: Retrieves members of a structure, considering XML attributes and ordering.

methods.name: add_map
methods.description: Serializes a map shape into nested 'entry' elements with 'key' and 'value'.
